# Decision Log

Этот документ является source of truth по уже принятым решениям и текущему плану выполнения.

Цель: не обсуждать и не переделывать одно и то же повторно. Если решение нужно изменить, сначала нужно явно предложить изменение пользователю, получить подтверждение и обновить все затронутые документы.

## Текущая фаза

2026-07-14 mixed publication campaign decision: a request such as “Deck #2, next 5 ordinary plus 1 full Polyglot on every channel” is one 51-channel immutable campaign, not 102 independent selectors. One no-spend plan chooses all assignments, claims all physical calendar slots through the shared earliest-gap allocator, batches Gemini metadata by four route environments, disables child persistence and performs one final durable merge. Playlist identity is part of the same fail-closed contract: complete route-authenticated owned-playlist/item discovery must resolve one existing ID or prove no stable identity match; a blank registry ID is never create permission, and the uploader repeats discovery immediately before one allowed create. Finalization requires exact video, schedule, playlist and playlist-item receipts. Source of truth: [YouTube Publication Campaigns](youtube-publication-campaigns.md).

2026-07-13 YouTube anti-duplicate and continuous-calendar decision: every active ordinary assignment and every Polyglot product slot has exactly one live video; apply never uses `allow_republish` or direct `publish_at`. Ordinary identity is `set + canonical support + target`; Polyglot slot identity is `set + canonical support + bundle + contentScope`, so a new targets hash cannot authorize a second active bundle video and `short_unverified` cannot satisfy `full`. Legacy target sets are compared without regard to order. Ordinary and Polyglot publishing share one cross-branch concurrency lock per physical support channel, one shared slot allocator and both durable publication registries, while different channels remain parallel. Before any metadata generation, render, TTS, thumbnail or upload, apply must perform authenticated live readback and pass the publication-control gate against the durable ordinary/Polyglot registries and shared calendar; a second read-only check refreshes the evidence immediately before upload, and the uploader rejects reports older than 30 minutes or candidates already active under a canonical/legacy semantic identity. Historical support rows are canonicalized as `EN-GB -> EN`, `ES -> ES-419`, `PT -> PT-BR`; multi-target legacy rows are Polyglot, not ordinary pairs. The common Polyglot bundle resolver enforces the ordinary same-viewer-language rule and configured fallbacks, including blocking `ES-419 -> ES` and `PT-BR -> PT`. Ordinary tails mean all eligible targets, while required Polyglot tails mean exactly the long/full `global_europe_core`, `romance_core`, `east_asia_core` and `slavic_core` slots per canonical channel. Scheduled planning fills completely empty dates before extra same-day slots, then continues chronologically; a manually requested later start date cannot create an earlier gap. Both bulk dispatchers are fire-and-forget by default and GitHub wrappers force `--no-watch`; status is checked later in one bounded readback. Successful state artifacts are merged by each child from fresh clones with bounded push retries so parallel channel jobs are not lost, and the Polyglot bulk parent never performs premature child-state recovery. The standard operational answer for “what is published / scheduled / missing / duplicated” comes from `.github/workflows/youtube-publication-control.yml`, which reads all four routes and produces one aggregate artifact without writes. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - Publication schedule and global calendar](video-lessons-strategy.md#publication-schedule-and-global-calendar).

2026-07-13 durable publication-map decision, extended 2026-07-14: the human answer must distinguish live API video rows from durable-only registry rows, and live duplicate groups from registry-only conflicts. `config/youtube-publication-snapshot.json` is the generated per-video readback snapshot, `config/youtube-playlist-discovery-snapshot.json` is the complete owned-playlist/item identity snapshot, and `docs/youtube-publication-map.md` is the compact human video view. The all-route workflow always produces all three as artifacts and may persist only those three files when `persist_snapshot=true`; that Git commit mode still performs no YouTube write. A snapshot is never an upload authorization because apply requires a newer strict per-support report with explicit complete pagination and no blockers. Duplicate recommendations may identify the only durable candidate, but deletion always remains an explicit, separately approved ID list with live pre-delete readback.

2026-07-13 calendar-reconciliation decision: a complete publication snapshot may repair missing local calendar evidence only through `npm run reconcile:youtube-calendar-snapshot`. Dry-run is the default. Local `--apply` may add or update only an unambiguous scheduled live row with a free physical-channel slot; it must skip every live duplicate ID, multiple semantic match, different-video assignment and slot collision. It does not call YouTube and cannot reschedule a video. Rebuild publication-control reports after local apply; unresolved duplicate-backed rows remain blockers until a separately approved duplicate cleanup and fresh readback.

2026-07-13 unclassified-upload decision: anti-duplicate evidence includes every ID returned by a channel uploads playlist, not only videos already inferable as the selected deck. The audit fetches `videos.list(status)` for all scanned IDs. A matched ID with `uploadStatus=not_returned` and a recent returned-status upload that cannot be assigned through durable registry ID or known course URL both fail closed. Only an exact ID recorded in `config/youtube-live-audit-exclusions.json` as `reviewed_non_product` may suppress the latter blocker; unclassified rows remain listed in `config/youtube-publication-snapshot.json` so they cannot disappear from operational review.

2026-07-13 playlist-registry and cover-readiness decision: a live ordinary video without a durable playlist ID proves only the `support + target` product pair, not that a playlist must be created. `npm run reconcile:youtube-playlist-registry-snapshot` may add a local planned row with exact source video IDs, blank `youtube_playlist_id` and `needsPlaylistDiscovery=true`; route-authenticated read-only playlist discovery must run before any creation decision. Playlist covers are deterministic assets rendered from an approved base and tracked in `config/youtube-cover-assets.json`. The durable publication snapshot reports file presence, Git tracking, playlist-ID readiness, uploaded readback and ID conflicts. Playlist-image apply is blocked unless the exact JPG is Git-tracked and manifest/registry IDs agree, and remains a separately approved YouTube write.

2026-06-21 YouTube channel source-of-truth decision: Google Sheet `Ютуб курсы FCL`, tab `YouTube каналы`, is the canonical source of truth for channel identity and operational status: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Uw5mO7Xy1asF-WlbRkphUCftaGDP6uVtu6xGgXD00_I/edit?gid=202606190#gid=202606190`. Local `config/youtube-channels.json`, `config/youtube-channel-inventory.json`, generated reports, GitHub artifacts and chat memory are mirrors/evidence for automation only. If they disagree with the live Sheet, the Sheet wins until a fresh API/Studio/readback intentionally updates it. Browser/Studio work must use Sheet `Current handle` / `Live channel URL` for navigation and `Support code` + `Channel ID / UC...` for durable identity; do not infer identity from row order, token filenames or temporary `New...` picker labels. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - YouTube channel strategy](video-lessons-strategy.md#12-youtube-channel-strategy).

2026-06-20 Codex operations decision: для Codex app/worktree/handoff/browser/Record & Replay/hooks/automation behavior принят отдельный source of truth [Codex Operations](codex-operations.md). Worktrees используются для docs-only, dry-run planners, safety scripts and non-secret refactors; local checkout остается местом для OAuth, `.local`, `.env.local`, YouTube Studio/account picker and final integration checks. Project-local safety commands are `npm run check:codex-workflow` and `npm run check:codex-readonly`; `.codex/hooks.json` is advisory until trusted in the Codex hook review UI. Read-only automations may run the bounded read-only bundle only; they must stop before OAuth, YouTube/Google writes, paid Gemini/VectorEngine/image/video generation, deployments, external-service mutations, Codex access tokens or Codex Sites unless the user explicitly approves that boundary. Source of truth: [Codex Operations](codex-operations.md).

2026-06-19 YouTube playlist architecture decision: для 50+ support/target language universe, 42 ordinary `content_sets` and isolated course families (`spanish_a1_*`, `oxford_vocabulary_*`, `hsk_classic_*`, `hsk3_*`) принят compact playlist strategy. Канал = support/viewer language; playlist = `targetLang + courseFamily + level/track`; stable identity = `playlist_key`, not localized title. Не создавать playlist per video, per single small deck, per `(supportLang, targetLang, setId)` or all possible 54 x 53 pairs. Regional/duplicate target variants such as `ES`/`ES-419`, `PT`/`PT-BR` and `EN`/`EN-GB` can coexist on the same support/viewer-language channel as separate playlists when content differs; they should not create separate viewer-language channels by default. Playlists are lazy-created only for flagship course families or after 3-5 ready videos. Automation must first add structured `config/youtube-channels.json`, `config/youtube-playlists.json` and `outputs/youtube-publish-ledger.jsonl`; Markdown `docs/video-lessons-registry.md` remains human-readable only and must not drive idempotent YouTube API writes. Source of truth and acceptance gates: [Video Lessons Strategy - Playlist architecture](video-lessons-strategy.md#13-playlist-architecture).

2026-06-19 public site URL collapse decision: decks/data may contain 54 language variants including `EN-GB`, `ES-419` and `PT-BR`, but `flashcardsluna.com` exposes 51 public language paths. Public channel/profile/video/QR/course links must map `EN` and `EN-GB` to `/en`, `ES` and `ES-419` to `/es`, and `PT` and `PT-BR` to `/pt`; do not use `/gb`, `/uk`, `/us`, `/mx`, `/br`, `/en-gb`, `/es-419` or `/pt-br` as public site language paths unless live routing changes and is verified. This does not remove regional variants from decks, generated videos, playlist keys, titles or metadata: `supportLang=RU` / `targetLang=PT-BR` remains `/ru/courses/...?...langs=pt-br`, while Portuguese/Brazilian-Portuguese viewer-language links start with `/pt`. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - YouTube channel strategy](video-lessons-strategy.md#12-youtube-channel-strategy).

2026-06-19 YouTube background music decision: user's original music may be used as quiet background audio, but it is Content ID / distributor-managed and therefore disabled by default until self-claim risk is checked. Do not add music to the first/current video deck batch. The first implementation and A/B check should happen on the second video deck pilot after the current silent batch is stable. The accepted path is local owned-track storage, `config/youtube-background-music.json` manifest, channel allowlist/whitelist evidence, deterministic seeded rotation written to metadata, quiet ducked mix under TTS, and private/unlisted YouTube Studio copyright readback before public batch use. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - Background music and Content ID safety](video-lessons-strategy.md#14-background-music-and-content-id-safety).

2026-06-19 YouTube background music cancellation: supersedes the earlier same-day second-deck music pilot idea. Do not add background music to LunaCards video lessons, including the second deck. Reason: expected direct music-rights revenue is too low relative to Content ID/self-claim risk, audio-mix complexity and possible harm to TTS intelligibility. Do not create `config/youtube-background-music.json`, do not add `musicTrackId` metadata and do not run music A/B or copyright test uploads unless the user explicitly reopens the decision. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - Background music and Content ID safety](video-lessons-strategy.md#14-background-music-and-content-id-safety).

2026-06-19 first video deck fresh-rerun decision: `home_kitchen_cookware_pilot_01` will be generated again as the first clean video batch, as if the video pipeline is starting now. Older local/GitHub video outputs and old `Pending` rows in `docs/video-lessons-registry.md` are historical working evidence only and must not be used as current publish readiness or upload state. The fresh batch uses current renderer/localization/QR/metadata/thumbnail/playlist rules, with background music still disabled. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - Fresh rerun of the first deck](video-lessons-strategy.md#fresh-rerun-of-the-first-deck).

2026-06-21 YouTube production visibility decision: production video publication should be `public`, not link-only/unlisted. `private` and `unlisted` remain valid only for explicit canaries, copyright checks or manual pre-publication review. The durable machine-readable publication tracker is `config/youtube-published-videos.json`; GitHub artifacts/`outputs/youtube-publish-ledger.jsonl` are per-run evidence and may expire or stay gitignored. Existing uploaded videos can be promoted without re-rendering through `.github/workflows/youtube-video-visibility.yml` / `npm run update:youtube-visibility`, with explicit public-write confirmations. Source of truth: [Video Lessons Strategy - Playlist architecture](video-lessons-strategy.md#13-playlist-architecture) and [Video Lessons Registry](video-lessons-registry.md#current-published--readback-rows).

The fix changed `config/course-metadata-taxonomy-labels.json` to Latin Gaj, made `scripts/lib/course-metadata-localization.mjs` enforce Latin-script identity for ordinary Latin metadata languages, updated `config/language-order.json`, `docs/language-specific-rules.md` and `docs/language-transcription-policy.md`, repaired current DB rows, and refreshed existing Google Sheets `Course Metadata!A1:BC5` ranges for all 28 current ordinary decks. Предыдущие pre-reset Google Sheets остаются историческими outputs, если deck не был rebuilt from the clean DB. Следующие колоды запускать только из `Deck Master Plan`: `planned/candidate -> spec_ready -> explicit approved_for_generation -> generation/import -> QA -> final export -> Google Sheet readback -> post-final audit -> delivery freshness`.

Scope проекта: мы создаем карточки, проверяем их качество и выдаем Google Sheets/spreadsheet-ready файлы. Всё после передачи файла пользователю не входит в текущую работу и не должно становиться частью плана карточек.

Нельзя начинать массовый перевод `5000 x 54` активных языковых вариантов до:

1. утверждения структуры рабочей базы;
2. создания Postgres schema;
3. пилотного набора на 30-50 items;
4. проверки Google Sheets export;
5. проверки QA-процесса;
6. отдельного QA-плана для risky transcription and language-specific rules.

## Принятые решения

| Тема | Решение | Source of truth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Базовый язык | English используется как canonical base для первичной генерации. После генерации карточки должны работать между любыми языковыми парами. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md) |
| Product development roadmap | Добавлен верхнеуровневый product direction map. Он связывает ordinary 180-deck backlog, course/exam releases, source-assisted quality, delivery automation and future non-language flashcard opportunities, but does not replace Deck Master Plan, Course Roadmap, QA Process or Data Delivery Pipeline. | [Product Development Roadmap](product-development-roadmap.md), [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Course And Exam Release Roadmap](course-exam-release-roadmap.md) |
| Единица базы | Собираем не просто слова, а `meaning units`. Одно английское слово может иметь несколько `meaning_id`, если значения разные. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Meaning-first localization | Не делаем отдельные базы для языковых пар. Каждый язык локализуется к общей смысловой базе: `meaning_id -> canonical English meaning -> semantic_scene -> language-specific entry/example`. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Semantic scene для примеров | Каждый base/context example, который переводится или экспортируется, должен иметь `semantic_scene`; переводы примеров должны сохранять сцену, а не копировать английскую грамматику дословно. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Language-specific rules | Для 54 активных языковых вариантов ведется отдельная v0-матрица display form, артиклей/рода, глаголов, classifiers, register and QA traps. Это guardrails, не native-speaker approval. | [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Regional language variants | Поддерживаются региональные language codes. Добавлены `EN-GB` British English, `ES-419` Latin American Spanish, `PT-BR` Brazilian Portuguese. `EN`, `ES`, `PT` не заменяются и сохраняют свои значения. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Learner-facing transcription format | Для всех 54 активных языковых вариантов сохраняется смешанная policy из `config/language-order.json` и `Language Transcription Policy`: IPA только для выбранных IPA-языков, native orthography copy для прозрачных/латинских языков, стандартная romanization/transliteration или learner romanization для нелатинских scripts. Tone numbers запрещены в финальном output; `ZH`, `VI`, `TH`, `LO` and `MY` должны сохранять tone marks / tone diacritics / tone-register notation according to policy. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Chinese script | `ZH` = Simplified Chinese. Traditional Chinese / `ZH-HANT` не активен и может быть добавлен только отдельным решением. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md) |
| Japanese examples | `JA` vocabulary entries use dictionary/plain form; default examples use learner-friendly neutral polite `です/ます` style. Entry form and example surface form are different fields. | [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Korean examples | `KO` vocabulary entries use dictionary/citation `-다` form; default examples use learner-friendly polite `해요체` / `-요` endings. Entry form and example surface form are different fields. | [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Norwegian Bokmål display | `NO`/`NB` stays Bokmål only. Use `en/et` learner article policy; do not mix Nynorsk; avoid `ei` in base display unless explicitly approved. | [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Размер базы | `5000` - ориентир, не жесткое число. Реальный объем определяется покрытием сценариев и quality gates. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Размер наборов | Не задаем жесткое правило "каждый набор по 50 слов". Используем target range; качество и покрытие темы важнее одинакового числа строк. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md) |
| Deck master plan | Перед созданием любой новой колоды нужно открыть `Deck Master Plan`, проверить, что deck есть в таблице или добавлен с разрешения, и заполнить pre-generation checklist. Это защита от mixed-bag колод в будущих чатах. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md) |
| Deck sorting | Очередь колод использует только целые `Sort` значения. Десятичные вставки вроде `24.10` запрещены, потому что ломают spreadsheet/DB sorting. При добавлении новой колоды нужно обновлять [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md); [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md) не содержит operational backlog. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md) |
| Course/exam release roadmap | Отдельные узнаваемые release-линейки вроде English Core 3000, IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC, HSK, JLPT, TOPIK and CEFR exam decks планируются в отдельном roadmap. Первый рекомендованный source-assisted course release remains `English Core 3000`; Oxford 3000/5000 now has a user-reported permission state and separate evidence/final-delivery gates. Cambridge EVP remains benchmark-only unless permission is obtained. | [Course And Exam Release Roadmap](course-exam-release-roadmap.md), [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [HSK Classic Release Plan](hsk-classic-release-plan.md) |

Prepared request draft still lives in `outputs/permission-requests/oxford-3000-5000-permission-request.md`; written OUP evidence is not stored in the project. Until evidence/final source approval, no `official`, `certified`, `approved by Oxford` or copied Oxford definitions/examples/pronunciations/audio are allowed. | [Oxford Vocabulary Release Plan](oxford-vocabulary-release-plan.md) |

| English Core variant and transcription scope | English Core 3000 first release is US English first for source pronunciation: `EN` remains the source/default English variant, and `EN-GB` is included in first-release word/display and example columns as a British English text variant. | Oxford vocabulary contour | Oxford 3000/5000 course remains `draft_needs_review`: use as benchmark only until source/list permission is confirmed. | Deck readiness statuses | Deck-planning statuses are `candidate`, `planned`, `spec_ready`, `approved_for_generation`, `generated`, `blocked`. `planned` means accepted backlog only; generation requires a complete deck spec and user approval. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Single-use next-deck approval | Earlier one-deck approvals were limited to the named next deck and do not grant blanket approval for the backlog. For any future deck, prepare the next Sort from Deck Master Plan, create/update its spec and candidate pool, pass `check-deck-specs`, confirm no generated-deck scope conflict, promote only that deck from `spec_ready` to `approved_for_generation`, then generate only if `check-deck-ready` passes. Ambiguity or failed checks must stop at `spec_ready`. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md) |
| V3 completion for Storage and Bathroom | `Kitchen Storage & Cleaning` and `Bathroom Essentials` were not regenerated because V3 parity review passed base word selection. The 2026-04-30 completion pass repaired only confirmed IPA rows through `import-transcription-repair.mjs` (Storage 231 rows, Bathroom 83 rows), imported fresh `transcription_policy`, `pronunciation_accuracy` and `target_example_pedagogical_quality` evidence, rebuilt final XLSX, updated the same Google Sheet file ids, verified readback and delivery freshness, and recorded post-final audit 1890/1890 pass rows for each deck. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Kitchen Storage & Cleaning spec](deck-specs/003-kitchen-storage-cleaning.md), [Bathroom Essentials spec](deck-specs/015-bathroom-essentials.md) |
| Status ownership contract | Deck Master Plan status controls generation readiness only. `content_sets.selection_status` controls selected/final composition and final requires `approved`. `quality_status` controls content quality and final requires `approved`/`generated_checked` plus structured evidence. `approved_for_generation` never means final-ready. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| QA evidence/status synchronization | `qa_reviews` is evidence, not a replacement for target row status. Final checks use latest-review semantics: older pass evidence is invalidated by newer non-pass in the same check family, unless a later manual approval exists for the same target/language. Drift is checked by `check-qa-evidence.mjs` and repaired by `sync-qa-statuses-from-evidence.mjs`. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| QA checked value hash | Text-bearing and deck-scoped selection QA evidence stores `checked_value_hash`. Final export recomputes the current value through `qa_checked_value_hash(...)` and blocks stale evidence after entry/example/transcription/Course Metadata or card-selection context edits. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Word selection quality gate | Final-ready card membership now requires `word_selection_quality` evidence keyed to `set_id::meaning_id` / `EN`. This gate checks that the selected word belongs in the exact deck, fits level/priority, is not rare padding/mixed-bag content, and was not reused only by matching English surface. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Example quality gate | Semantic preservation не доказывает качество базового английского примера. Final-ready context example теперь требует два EN gate: `base_example_alignment` and `example_quality`; `example_quality` blocks mass templates, generic placeholders and unnatural verb-object pairs before translations are trusted. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Semantic scene alignment gate | Final export must fail when an English context example and its `semantic_scene` drift apart. Generic placeholders such as `is shown` / `in a ... object scene` are not allowed for examples that express a specific location, state or action. The deterministic checker runs in `db-qa-set`, `check-qa-evidence`, final export and post-final audit. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Target semantic scene alignment gate | Target-language examples must preserve the current `semantic_scene`, not only pass generic semantic evidence. The deterministic marker table covers `on_the_counter`, `in_the_drawer` and `beside_the_bowl` for `Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies` and reused counter/drawer scenes in older generated kitchen decks. Unsupported scenes now fail closed unless current hash-scoped `semantic_preservation` evidence contains scene-slot proof bound to the current English example, target example, `meaning_id`, `language_code` and core scene fields. Marker/proof expansion must not hide true drift. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies spec](deck-specs/004-kitchen-small-tools-supplies.md) |
| Target example naturalness gate | Final-ready translated examples require a second example QA layer, `target_example_naturalness`, in addition to `semantic_preservation`. `semantic_scene` describes meaning, not literal helper words; target examples must use natural language-specific constructions. V1 deterministic smoke check blocks the confirmed RU pattern `находится/находятся + adjective/state` while allowing true locatives such as `находится на столешнице`. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Cross-language transcription fallback gate | Final/export gates now block mass pseudo-English romanization collapse across high-risk languages. `scripts/check-transcription-cross-language-fallbacks.mjs` fails a 3-language high-risk batch when 60%+ comparable rows are identical across all batch languages, and fails a deck when 5+ of `BN`/`HI`/`NE`/`SI`/`TA`/`TE`/`KN`/`ML` share normalized transcription on at least 10 cards or 40% of active cards. Smaller loanword-like overlaps are warnings. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Number-example grammar gate | Number-heavy/quantity decks require `number_example_grammar` evidence for translated examples. The gate proves number + noun agreement, classifier/counter/linker requirements, script consistency and EN scene preservation; generic “short/useful example” evidence is not enough. These decks use 1 language per generation batch by default, while the importer keeps max 3 as a hard ceiling. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Production stage runner | Production deck creation is no longer controlled by prompt memory alone. `scripts/run-deck-production.mjs` is the stage controller for `prepare`, `base`, `draft-preflight`, `batch-import`, `qa`, `export`, `deliver` and `complete`; it writes `outputs/runs/<set_id>/<run_id>.json`, uses `deck_generation_runs` for the runtime lock and records current artifact hashes. `scripts/check-deck-run-state.mjs` is the read-only resume/status command. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Post-reset Home Rooms First route | The first post-reset production route is reordered to feel room-first for learners: rebuild the kitchen path, then bathroom, bedroom, living room, dining room, entryway/furniture and nearby home-space decks before switching to Core Foundation. `Numbers & Counting` remains a historical pre-reset Sort 5 delivery, but in the current post-reset Deck Master Plan it is Sort 16. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Deck Specs Registry](deck-specs/README.md), [Content Coverage Map](content-coverage-map.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md) |
| Kitchenware Basics post-reset pilot approval | On 2026-05-03 the user explicitly approved launching Sort 1 `Kitchenware Basics` / `home_kitchen_cookware_pilot_01` through the production stage runner. This approval is limited to this single deck. Runner stages, runtime lock, draft preflight, batch imports, QA, export, Google Sheet readback, post-final audit and delivery freshness still control actual readiness. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Deck Specs Registry](deck-specs/README.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Pre-import source-assisted gate | Language batches are generated as draft JSONL first, checked by `check-language-batch-source-preflight.mjs`, repaired until hard blockers are 0, and only then imported. Optional tools such as Epitran, UniMorph, Apertium, FreeDict and OpenPhonemizer can propose candidates/warnings, but tool-only and dictionary output remains `source_partial` until sense-matched and cannot approve a final row by itself. | [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Pre-import lexical candidate sources | Kaikki/Wiktionary target-language gloss/link lookup, parsed DBnary EN->target translations streamed from local `.tgz` / `.ttl.bz2`, targeted FreeDict EN->target dictionaries and configured Apertium pairs are now source-candidate layers in pre-import source preflight. They emit `source_partial` translation candidates and repair hints, not automatic exact sense proof. Google Translate / external MT can only appear as report-only sanity in `external_mt_sanity`. | [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Broad source download layer | Broad raw source downloads are allowed when they improve pre-import review, but they remain ignored local cache, not committed product data. On 2026-05-03 the project added reproducible bulk source groups for FreeDict, Tatoeba, OPUS, Wikidata lexical dumps, Concepticon/CLICS/NorthEuraLex and PanLex retry targets. FreeDict/Tatoeba/Wikidata/CLDF are local source candidates; OPUS is staged by corpus/language; PanLex stays unavailable until a successful retry. These sources can create candidates, warnings and collocation hints, but cannot override `meaning_id`, `meaning_note`, `semantic_scene`, language-specific rules or QA hashes. | [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Bulk source indexes in preflight | Broad raw sources must not remain inert archives. `scripts/build-bulk-source-indexes.mjs` builds ignored cache indexes for Tatoeba, OPUS, Wikidata lexemes, Concepticon/NorthEuraLex, Hunspell and PanLex when available. `check-language-batch-source-preflight` now reports bulk `translation_candidates`, `example_collocation_candidates`, `concept_sanity` and `spelling_sanity`; all are source_partial repair signals. OPUS missing pair URLs are `unavailable_pair`, UniMorph missing repositories are `unavailable_source`, and PanLex DNS/timeout remains `deferred_retry`, not a reason to block unrelated source fetches. | [Reference Sources](reference-sources.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Full deck QA contour | New decks and refreshed final exports must pass deterministic batch/deck gates in addition to AI/source-backed QA: entry/display cross-language fallback, sibling-copy warnings, meaning contrast, EN base-example naturalness, transcription fallback/collapse, target-example naturalness, regional variant quality for configured risk rows, and QA hash coverage. Mass/systemic fallback is `fail`; sibling/regional/loanword ambiguity is warning/needs-review evidence unless another gate proves a blocker. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Operational order | Единственный исполняемый порядок колод - [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md). Content roadmap and build plan explain principles, but do not override Deck Master Plan order/statuses. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Content roadmap | Каждая большая тема идет через vocabulary-only лестницу: quick-win Basics -> Actions/Everyday Use Words -> Situation/Problem Words -> deeper expansion only if useful. CEFR хранится в metadata, но названия колод должны показывать тему и пользу, а не только `A1/A2/B1`. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Long-term everyday deck contour | Для максимального покрытия повседневных слов зафиксирован расширенный operational queue до `Sort 180`: core reusable language, personal life, household, food, city/transport, shopping/services, money, documents, health, school/work, technology, leisure, social life, nature and time. После pilot идти по этому порядку из Deck Master Plan, а не выбирать тему заново из переписки. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Coverage Map](content-coverage-map.md) |
| Post-Kitchenware execution order | После `Kitchenware Basics` следующий порядок берется только из [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md). Roadmap объясняет почему quick-win kitchen continuation полезен, но не задает `Sort`/status queue. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md) |
| Next generation slots | There is no blanket active approved backlog. The documented single-use next-deck approval rule can cover exactly one following Sort deck only if its spec is prepared, `check-deck-specs` passes, generated-deck scope conflicts are ruled out, `check-deck-ready` passes and no product/scope ambiguity appears. Other `planned`/`candidate`/`spec_ready` rows remain not generation-ready. Completed repair/delivery work on an existing deck is not approval for another deck. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Deck Specs Registry](deck-specs/README.md), [Content Coverage Map](content-coverage-map.md) |
| Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies generation and repair | `Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies` (`home_kitchen_small_tools_supplies_a2`, Sort 4) is current post-reset generated coverage. It was rebuilt through the runner on 2026-05-06 from a 24-card cleaned candidate pool, then retrofitted on 2026-05-13 to 32 cards by explicit Kitchenware meaning reuse: `grater`, `whisk`, `rolling pin`, `measuring cup`, `measuring spoon`, `strainer`, `can opener` and `bottle opener`. The retrofit reused existing `meaning_id` rows instead of creating duplicate meanings, corrected stale candidate IDs, repaired inherited MY/HY/TH transcription issues, refreshed current QA evidence, re-exported the final workbook, updated the same Google Sheet `1L4kOCdjAU0zkXieZgmaaGqtpy6fwi9A9bTnZZrNTVNw`, passed readback, post-final audit 1728/1728 and delivery freshness. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Deck Specs Registry](deck-specs/README.md), [Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies spec](deck-specs/004-kitchen-small-tools-supplies.md), [Content Coverage Map](content-coverage-map.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |

| Массовая генерация | Не переводить сразу `5000 x 54` активных языковых вариантов. Идем через pilot, v0 Core, v1 Foundation, v2 Expansion. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Translation batch size | Для одной готовой колоды normal language batch имеет hard maximum 3 языка. Для number-heavy / quantity / high-risk grammar decks рабочий default - 1 язык за batch; меньше 3 языков также использовать для естественного хвоста, проблемного языка, точечной перепроверки или исправления после failed QA. Для Pilot 1 первый batch зафиксирован как `ES, FR, ZH`; второй batch `DE, IT, PT, JA, KO, VI` уже создан как разовое исключение до фиксации нового default. Не переводить все оставшиеся языки одной операцией без отдельного решения. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Accelerated batch delivery | Чтобы ускорить текущую колоду, после каждого accepted language batch обновлять Postgres и запускать QA, но не пересобирать `.xlsx` / Google Sheets после каждого batch. Для number-heavy decks one-language batch остается default даже при ускоренном режиме. Spreadsheet пересобирается в конце покрытия 54 языков или по отдельной просьбе пользователя. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Parallel deck runs | Ускорение делаем параллельными разными колодами, а не большими языковыми batch внутри одной колоды. Runtime-состояние "уже в работе" хранится в Postgres `deck_generation_runs`, не правкой `Deck Master Plan`. Один `set_id` не может иметь два active `running` locks. | [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md), [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md) |
| Meaning-first reuse | Translation memory переиспользует только `meaning_id` + language entries. Одинаковое английское surface word не является основанием для reuse: `table_furniture` and `table_data` остаются разными смыслами. Explicit `meaning_id` reuse is safe only with full fingerprint match; partial explicit matches go to `needs_review_explicit_partial_match`. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Structured imports after Pilot 1 | Новые колоды больше не должны создаваться ручными SQL seed кусками. Base deck data enters via `scripts/import-deck-base-data.mjs`; language batches enter via `scripts/import-language-batch.mjs` with max 3 language variants and raw `generated` statuses until QA. Pilot 1 seeds remain for reproducibility. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |

Агент делает несколько QA-проходов сам и при сомнениях сверяется с проверенными источниками, но `approved` ставится только там, где реально была человеческая проверка, практически EN/RU. Остальные языки после AI/source-backed QA не получают `approved` автоматически. | [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| QA passes | Для переводов и экспорта используем 8 pre-final QA-слоев: documentation/scope, selection, structural, English/RU review, translation coverage, semantic preservation, grammar/register, transcription/export. Production delivery дополнительно требует обязательный post-final linguistic audit after final export/upload. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Semantic QA split | Structural semantic scene existence and translated-example semantic preservation are separate gates. `semantic_scene` schema v1 core fields are `target_object`, `target_display`, `subject_number`, `action_or_state`, `state_or_location`, `tense_aspect`, `topic_context`; generated_checked translated examples require structured `qa_reviews` evidence with `check_family=semantic_preservation` and `pass_id=semantic_preservation_...` keyed to `set_id::meaning_id::example_id`. `run-ai-qa.mjs` makes this executable together with entry-form and transcription-policy checks, though the semantic judgment remains AI/source-backed. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Generated to generated_checked path | Raw `generated` rows can become `generated_checked` only through structured QA evidence. `run-ai-qa.mjs --dry-run` is a review-payload export only and cannot create pass evidence for final delivery; pass rows marked dry-run/synthetic are rejected or ignored by final gates. Normal deck delivery is agent-owned: Codex reviews the payload, writes a separate checked JSONL and imports it with `import-ai-qa-results.mjs`. Missing external provider credentials is not a user blocker; optional non-dry provider QA is allowed only when credentials already exist in the agent runtime. Mass AI QA never sets `approved`; RU approval remains a separate manual review flow. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Reuse generator | `generate-meaning-reuse-plan.mjs` строит fail-closed plan перед созданием новых meaning units. Safe apply разрешен только для explicit `meaning_id` или exact fingerprint match; surface-only совпадения уходят в review/block. Скрипт не копирует translated examples между колодами. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Excel role | Excel/Google Sheets используется как review/report/export для пользователя, но не как рабочий source of truth. Ручные RU review-решения становятся частью базы только через `export-review-decisions-template.mjs` и `import-review-decisions.mjs`. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Финальная выдача | Пользовательский deliverable - Google Sheets / spreadsheet-ready `.xlsx`. Каждая колода/учебный набор получает отдельный Google Sheets документ. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Cloud-ready перенос | Проект можно переносить в облако только как воспроизводимый runtime: git remote + Postgres restore/dump + env setup + checks. Переключатель `Cloud` сам по себе не переносит локальный Docker/Postgres, `.env`, незакоммиченные файлы или Drive folder placement. | [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md) |
| GitHub remote | Создан private GitHub repo `lalishka/cards-ramil-ready`; локальная ветка `main` отслеживает `origin/main`. | [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md) |
| 180-deck automation | Автоматизация 180 колод допустима только fail-closed: запускать только `approved_for_generation`, после spec/check-deck-ready/runtime-lock, batch generation, QA evidence, final export and Drive-folder check. `planned`, `candidate`, `spec_ready`, `generated` and `blocked` не запускаются как production automation. | [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md), [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Google Drive delivery | Финальные файлы должны сохраняться в целевую папку `Слова для FlashcarsLuna`. Preferred automated path: `scripts/upload-spreadsheet-to-drive-folder.mjs` with OAuth Desktop client; it creates the native Google Sheet with the target `folderId` via Drive API. For Oxford 3000/5000, a user request to save to Google Drive after source-package QA means final Google Sheets delivery like Part 001: export US/UK workbooks, upload native Google Sheets, run readback, update contract/docs and gate report. Non-final QA/report artifacts may be saved as raw files with `scripts/upload-drive-file-to-folder.mjs` only when the user explicitly asks for report/artifact/evidence storage; this is not final Google Sheets delivery. Service-account auth is fallback only for Shared Drive / explicitly shared setups. Если connector не умеет указать `parent/folder` или move/update-file, valid deliverable is local `.xlsx` + Google Sheet link + explicit `folder placement blocker`; файл не считается размещенным в папке без подтверждения. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md) |
| Working vs final export | Working preview export можно собирать для проверки структуры и частично заполненных языков, но он обязан быть помечен как `not final-ready`. Final export должен падать с ошибкой, если нет полного покрытия words/examples/transcriptions по всем 54 языковым вариантам или есть non-final statuses. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Generated publish policy | Без носителей языки не становятся `approved`. Raw `generated` - сырой AI/output and never final-ready. После AI/source-backed QA строки могут получить реальный DB status `generated_checked` only with matching structured `qa_reviews` evidence containing exact target, reviewer, reviewed_at, check family, result summary and pass/batch id; `needs_review` и `blocked` не попадают в final export без отдельного решения. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Формат Google Sheets | Финальные vocabulary-листы идут широким grouped-column форматом: translations -> examples -> word transcriptions. Во всех трех блоках повторяется один порядок 54 языков из `config/language-order.json`. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Spreadsheet contract v1 | Обязательные листы: main vocabulary sheet, `Course Metadata`, `Deck Metadata`, `Card Metadata`, `_qa_status`, `_languages`. Stable row key в workbook: `card_key = set_id::meaning_id`; `meaning_id` остается semantic key рабочей базы. В Sheets используется `NO`, в базе `NB`. Final export требует ноль пустых words/examples/transcriptions, final-ready statuses, context-example gates and generated_checked QA evidence. Machine-readable contract lives in `config/spreadsheet-contract-v1.json`. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Language order source | Машинный source of truth порядка 54 языков - `config/language-order.json`; scripts must import it and `scripts/check-language-order.mjs` checks references plus the actual transcription policy matrix language names/spreadsheet codes/db codes/transcription formats/order/count. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Workbook на колоду | Для каждой колоды/учебного набора создается отдельный Google Sheets документ. Название документа должно отражать категорию/колоду. Внутри документа есть основной лист карточек, `Course Metadata`, `Deck Metadata`, `Card Metadata`, `_README`, `_qa_status`, `_languages` и при необходимости служебные листы. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Pilot Content](pilot-content.md) |
| Course metadata sheet | Для каждой колоды в workbook добавляется отдельный лист `Course Metadata` со строками `Title`, `Description`, `Module` и `Category`. Колонки идут в том же фиксированном порядке 54 языков, что и vocabulary-листы. `Module` / `Category` - короткие localized mobile-app labels для deck-level domain/area (`context_domain` / `context_area` по смыслу), например `Home` / `Kitchen`, `Дом` / `Кухня`; длинное `content_sets.category` не используется как mobile category. `Title` <= 25, `Description` <= 60, `Module` <= 25, `Category` <= 25 символов в каждом языке. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Pilot Content](pilot-content.md) |
| Deck/Card metadata sheets | `Deck Metadata` обязателен для deck-level структуры: `set_id`, `slug`, taxonomy, level range, roadmap stage, learning goal, next deck ids, selection/quality statuses and sheet contract version. `Card Metadata` обязателен для row-level данных: `card_key`, `set_id`, `meaning_id`, context example id/key, main sheet row, POS, level, priority, taxonomy and statuses. CEFR-уровень хранится структурно в metadata и не заменяется текстом title/description. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Level labels | Для всех колод обязателен `level_label`: `Basic`, `Elementary`, `Pre-Intermediate`, `Intermediate`, `Upper-Intermediate`, `Advanced`, `Proficiency`. CEFR хранится отдельно в `level_min` / `level_max`; `level_label` нужен как понятная шкала уровня в файле. | [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Course metadata copy rule | `Title` и `Description` должны быть human-readable, topic-specific и пригодными для списка/каталога колод: коротко, точно, уникально, без наборов ключевых слов, без generic labels и без повторяющегося boilerplate. `Description` дополняет `Title`, а не обязано его дублировать. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Course metadata level signal | `Course Metadata.Description` обязано содержать exact DB-backed `content_set_localizations.level_signal`, например `Basic level` / `Базовый уровень`. `level_signal` не выводится как отдельная строка в пользовательский `Course Metadata` sheet; машинный source of truth для уровня остается `Deck Metadata.level_label`. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Course metadata punctuation | `Course Metadata.Title` и `Description` являются sentence-like user-facing строками: обе завершаются локализованным sentence terminator, а `Description` вводит exact DB-backed `level_signal` как отдельное короткое предложение. Final export and DB QA fail closed on missing title punctuation or a glued level phrase. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Set-driven export | Google Sheets export должен быть `set_id`-driven: Course Metadata читается из `content_set_localizations`, sheet/file names строятся из текущего `content_set`, а row count проверяется по target range, не по числу 50. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Транскрипция в листах | В карточке и финальном Google Sheets export есть ровно одно пользовательское поле `transcription` на язык. Оно создается только для слов, не для примеров. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Transcription role | `transcription` - вспомогательная learner-подсказка в карточках; audio будет основным источником произношения. QA блокирует пустые, неверные и вводящие в заблуждение транскрипции, но minor practical romanization/transliteration variants не должны стопорить карточку, если слово понятно and structured QA evidence exists. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Native orthography в transcription | Для языков с policy `native orthography` финальное поле `transcription` повторяет отображаемое слово. Пустых transcription-ячеек в финальном export быть не должно. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Tone-aware transcription policy | `ZH` requires Hanyu Pinyin with tone marks; `VI` repeats native orthography with tone marks; `TH` uses Paiboon-style learner romanization with vowel tone diacritics; `LO` uses Vientiane-based learner romanization with vowel tone diacritics; `MY` uses practical romanization with tone/register notation. Old no-tone RTGS/BGN/native-script forms are not final-ready. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md) |
| Deterministic transcription shape gate | Старое QA evidence не спасает плохую форму `transcription`. `db-qa-set`, `check-qa-evidence`, final export and language-batch import preflight run a deterministic shape gate for IPA, native orthography, romanization, EN/EN-GB verb display and tone-aware `ZH`/`TH`/`LO`/`MY`. For native-script romanization languages, the gate blocks full fallback to `canonical_english`, partial English-tail leaks such as `kuhnenski-kitcen-scale` or `khrua-citrus-juicer-ǎa`, and one-language collapse such as RU `kuhonnye` repeated across a deck. All callers must pass `canonical_english`; `scripts/check-transcription-fallbacks.mjs` is the compact smoke checker for English fallback leaks and `scripts/check-transcription-intra-language-collapse.mjs` is the compact smoke checker for per-language collapse. | [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Deterministic example casing gate | `example_text` follows target-language sentence norms, while `display_word` stays dictionary/base form and is not artificial Title Case. `scripts/check-example-casing.mjs`, `db-qa-set`, final export and post-final audit block lowercase-start examples in sentence-case languages; scripts/languages without sentence capitalization, including `KA` Georgian, are ignored for this capitalization requirement. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Language Specific Rules](language-specific-rules.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Kitchenware tone and KA fallback repair | Pilot 1 `Kitchenware Basics` repaired and reuploaded on 2026-04-28. The first repair changed transcription-facing columns `ES-419`, `TH`, `LO`, `MY`. The strengthened fallback gate later found one older Georgian row, `KA` / `home_kitchen_spatula_tool_01`; it was repaired from English `spatula` to Georgian romanization `sp'at'ula`, rechecked with `entry_form`, `transcription_policy` and `semantic_preservation`, exported again and uploaded to the same Google Sheet file id `1ua3NyyIL6YD1GczT06Q4yISdvnor9YYiLuiIU7qgIM4`. `Cooking Actions` was checked under the same fallback gate and had 0 blockers. | [Pilot Content](pilot-content.md), [Kitchenware Basics spec](deck-specs/001-kitchenware-basics.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Kitchenware final linguistic audit | Pilot 1 `Kitchenware Basics` received a post-final deterministic linguistic audit on 2026-04-28. The latest audit after the 2026-04-29 semantic-scene alignment repair checked 2700 rows (50 cards x 54 language variants) for entry/example/casing/transcription/semantic-scene/status sanity and found 0 deterministic blockers: `outputs/audit/final_linguistic_audit_home_kitchen_cookware_pilot_01_20260429T022115Z_results_summary.json`. Evidence is stored as `check_family=final_linguistic_audit`; this is not native approval or a 100% guarantee. | [Pilot Content](pilot-content.md), [QA Process](qa-process.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Kitchenware Basics spec](deck-specs/001-kitchenware-basics.md) |
| Примеры | Примеры должны быть очень простые, контролируемые, одинаковые по смыслу во всех языках и привязанные к контексту. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Артикли | В английском и целевых языках использовать артикли/род/грамматические маркеры, если они реально есть и полезны изучающему. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Display form by POS | English verbs показывать как `to + base verb`; German nouns показывать с `der/die/das` для рода; German verbs показывать инфинитивом без искусственного `zu`. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| Пересечения наборов | Пересечения нормальны. Один смысл = один `meaning_id`, разные наборы связываются через `set_memberships`. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md) |
| Типы контента | Текущий production/export режим: vocabulary-only. Генерируем только vocabulary decks и core foundation vocabulary. Ready-phrase, multi-turn, functional phrase and mixed decks не входят в scope проекта. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Learner-facing deck grouping | Vocabulary decks должны быть чистыми и удобными для изучения: часть речи, закрытая группа, предметная зона, действия, опции или problem words внутри темы. Жизненные domains из benchmark (`bank`, `clinic`, `rental`) сначала разбиваются на отдельные vocabulary/action/problem-word decks, а не смешиваются в одну карточную колоду. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [External Content Benchmark](external-content-benchmark.md) |
| Non-noun foundation | План карточек не должен быть noun-only. Обязательны reusable layers: `Practical Action Verbs`, `Object States & Qualities`, prepositions/connectors/frequency words. Глаголы в English display идут как `to + base verb`. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Place/object vocabulary decks | Для практических тем разрешены и предпочтительны чистые noun/object колоды по месту, полке, витрине, комнате, транспортной зоне или category: airport objects, school supplies, fruit basics, cinema basics, cafe table items. Готовые реплики не создаются; проблемы превращаются в problem-word vocabulary decks. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md) |
| Broad topic split | Большие темы (`Food`, `Home`, `Transport`, etc.) обязательно дробятся на подколоды по scope, уровню, частотности и практической важности. `Food Basics` содержит частые early-useful items; редкие продукты вроде lobster/octopus уходят в отдельные narrower или advanced decks. | [Content Architecture](content-architecture.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Beverage split | Напитки не прятать внутри `Food Basics` или `Cafe Food`. Для них есть отдельные vocabulary-only колоды: `Drink Basics`, `Coffee & Espresso Drinks`, `Tea & Hot Drinks`, `Juices, Smoothies & Cold Drinks`, `Cafe Drink Options`. Брендовые/региональные названия вроде `frappuccino` использовать осторожно: по умолчанию предпочитать generic learner-safe term, если язык не использует заимствование как обычное слово. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md) |
| Fast food and alcohol | Fast food/takeaway фиксируется отдельно как слова: `Fast Food Basics`, `Sauces & Extras`, `Takeaway & Dine-In Words`. Не делать карточки-фразы `to go`, `for here`, `I will eat here`; вместо этого использовать vocabulary items `takeaway`, `dine-in`, `cutlery`, `sauce`, `lid`, `straw`. Alcohol vocabulary фиксируется как adult/useful candidate, не как kids/basic deck: `Alcoholic Drinks Basics`, `Bar & Alcohol Words`; стиль нейтральный, с non-alcoholic options. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [Content Roadmap](product-content-roadmap.md), [Card Taxonomy](card-taxonomy.md) |
| Части речи | Part of speech - metadata/tag, а не верхний уровень taxonomy. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Уровни | Используем официальные CEFR-уровни `A1`, `A2`, `B1`, `B2`, `C1`, `C2`. `A0` не используется в данных. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Content priority | `priority_band` отделяет практическую важность карточки от CEFR и частотности. Разрешенные значения: `survival`, `core`, `common`, `useful`, `advanced`. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md) |
| Register/formality | Vocabulary хранит dictionary/base form. Примеры используют естественную learner-friendly форму. Если дружеская/вежливая форма сильно отличается, это фиксируется в usage note или отдельной vocabulary/lexical item только после явного решения. | [Card Content Model](card-content-model.md) |
| Deck spec registry | `Deck Master Plan` остается единственным operational order/status source. Физические specs живут в `docs/deck-specs/`: `candidate`/`planned` могут быть без spec, но `spec_ready`, `approved_for_generation` and `generated` обязаны иметь registry row and spec file. Перед генерацией конкретной колоды `check-deck-ready` должен пройти и требует `approved_for_generation`. | [Deck Master Plan](deck-master-plan.md), [deck-specs/README.md](deck-specs/README.md) |
| Spreadsheet row key | `card_key = set_id::meaning_id` is the stable row key in the workbook. `meaning_id` still travels in `Card Metadata` as the semantic key for the working base. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md) |
| QA statuses | Используем `draft`, `generated`, `generated_checked`, `needs_review`, `approved`, `blocked`. Generated не равно approved and raw `generated` is not final-ready. Pronunciation fields may also use `not_applicable`. | [Content Build Plan](content-build-plan.md), [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |
| Portuguese | `PT` = European Portuguese для Португалии. `PT-BR` = Brazilian Portuguese. Не смешивать эти варианты. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Spanish | `ES` = Spanish (Spain). `ES-419` = Latin American Spanish. Не смешивать региональную лексику, если варианты расходятся. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| English variants | `EN` = American English / US default and canonical base. `EN-GB` = British English для Великобритании и не является canonical source. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Norwegian | Используем Norwegian Bokmål. В Google Sheets используется `NO`; в базе хранится `NB`. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Filipino | Используем Filipino с кодом `TL`. `FIL/fil` не использовать как основной код. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Kazakh | `KK`: `native_word` хранится казахской кириллицей. Финальная `transcription` хранится латиницей по practical Cyrillic-to-Latin transliteration. | [Language Transcription Policy](language-transcription-policy.md) |
| Google Drive folder | Финальные файлы идут в папку "Слова для FlashcarsLuna". Если connector создал файл вне папки, это фиксируется как folder placement blocker; локальный `.xlsx` остается в проекте до ручного перемещения пользователем или повторной загрузки через `scripts/upload-spreadsheet-to-drive-folder.mjs` в нужную папку. Raw QA/report artifacts use `scripts/upload-drive-file-to-folder.mjs` with a local manifest and no Workspace conversion. OAuth client хранится локально в `.secrets/google-oauth-client.json`, не в git. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Cloud Automation](cloud-automation.md) |
| Delivery manifest | Final export writes local `*_delivery.json`; Drive upload/update verifies title/parent folder and updates the manifest with Google Sheet id/url, folder verification status and whether the uploaded Sheet matches the current workbook. Re-upload of an existing deck should use `--file-id=<existing_google_sheet_id>` to avoid duplicates. | [Data Delivery Pipeline](data-delivery-pipeline.md), [Database Schema](database-schema.md) |

## Текущий spreadsheet export

Текущая выдача создается из Postgres set-driven export script, а не из ручного общего шаблона:

```text
scripts/export-flashcards-working-sheet.mjs
outputs/google-sheets/FlashcardsLuna_home-kitchen-kitchenware-basics_working.xlsx
```

Обязательные листы workbook:

- `_README`;
- `_languages`;
- main vocabulary sheet;
- `Course Metadata`;
- `Deck Metadata`;
- `Card Metadata`;
- `_qa_status`.

Проект создает vocabulary/core-foundation карточки и spreadsheet-выдачу. Готовые фразы, диалоги и смешанные наборы не входят в текущий scope.

## 2026-04-29: V2 Systemic QA Contour

Decision: implement V2 as repair-first gates, not as full regeneration of old decks. Existing final decks are rebuilt only when the base layer is fundamentally bad; otherwise confirmed errors are repaired through narrow helpers and fresh evidence.

Implemented gates:

- mandatory evidence families: `target_example_lexical_anchor`, `entry_form_register`, `semantic_granularity`, `article_gender_marker_consistency`;
- deterministic gates: script/language identity, article/gender/marker consistency, semantic granularity, example template diversity, target example lexical anchor and delivery freshness;
- `db/migrations/019_v2_quality_hashes.sql` so V2 evidence becomes stale after relevant entry/example/scene/rule-version changes;
- final export and `check-qa-evidence` now require the V2 evidence layers and rerun deterministic V2 blockers;
- `run-final-linguistic-audit.mjs` repeats V2 deterministic checks as a post-final sanity layer;
- `import-ai-qa-results.mjs --bulk` imports large non-transcription QA evidence files set-based, and auxiliary V2 families write evidence without overriding a non-pass primary status.

Rollout result: the four existing final decks passed V2 hard blockers. A later safe repair pass on 2026-04-29 used repair-first handling instead of full regeneration:

- confirmed semantic/lexical repairs: `SV` `pot` changed from `en kastrull` to `en gryta` with refreshed example/transcription evidence, and `RU` `rinse` changed from `ополаскивать` to `промывать` to match the existing natural example `Промыть латук.`;
- metadata-only repairs: split-out article/gender/number metadata was filled for `Bathroom Essentials` and `Kitchen Storage & Cleaning` through `import-entry-metadata-repair.mjs` without changing display words, examples or transcriptions;
- follow-up metadata-only repair: 24 `FR` rows in `Bathroom Essentials` and 19 `FR` rows in `Kitchen Storage & Cleaning` had `le` singular masculine display forms but `grammatical_number=plural`; only `grammatical_number` was corrected to `singular`, with fresh `article_gender_marker_consistency`, `entry_form`, `entry_form_register` and `semantic_granularity` evidence;
- accepted review artifacts: `JA` `pan`/`frying pan` and `DE` `towel`/`hand towel` shared forms were retained with review evidence because no higher-frequency non-degrading household contrast was confirmed;
- remaining warnings are documented artifacts for plausible loanwords, sibling/regional same-form rows and inflected lexical anchors, not hard blockers.

The safe repair pass also fixed two pipeline issues: transcription repair no longer overwrites entry/source notes, and QA status sync treats legacy empty-language base English evidence as `EN` when selecting latest evidence. All four older final workbooks were re-exported, uploaded to the same Google Sheet file ids, audited post-final with 0 fail / 0 needs_review, re-exported after audit import and verified with `check-delivery-freshness`. After the French number metadata follow-up, `Bathroom Essentials` and `Kitchen Storage & Cleaning` were re-exported, reuploaded to the same Google Sheet file ids and reaudited with 1890/1890 pass each. `Kitchen Small Tools & Supplies` was then generated from its approved Sort 4 spec and initially delivered with 1296/1296 audit pass rows; that Google Sheet briefly became delivery-stale after the later RU target-scene repair, then was refreshed again in the later generated-deck delivery refresh.

## 2026-04-29: V3 Pronunciation, Pedagogy and Sheet Readback Gates

Decision: add V3 gates before generating more decks. V3 separates `transcription_policy` shape from `pronunciation_accuracy` content accuracy, separates target-language naturalness from target-example pedagogical usefulness, and makes Google Sheet readback part of delivery freshness.

Implemented gates:

- mandatory evidence families: `pronunciation_accuracy` for IPA rows and `target_example_pedagogical_quality` for translated examples;
- deterministic gates: `scripts/check-ipa-transcription-sanity.mjs` and `scripts/check-target-example-pedagogical-quality.mjs`;
- `scripts/check-google-sheet-readback.mjs`, plus delivery manifest fields `google_sheet_readback_status`, `google_sheet_readback_verified_at`, `google_sheet_readback_sample_count`, `google_sheet_readback_workbook_sha256` and `google_sheet_readback_errors`;
- final export, `check-qa-evidence`, language-batch preflight, `db-qa-set.sh`, final linguistic audit and delivery freshness now run or require the V3 checks;
- `qa_checked_value_hash(...)` now covers the V3 families and makes old `example_quality` evidence stale under the stronger base pedagogical rule version.

Rollout baseline on the four current decks found real blockers under V3, so the prior V2 "final" status must not be described as V3-current:

- `home_kitchen_cookware_pilot_01`: 0 deterministic IPA sanity blockers after the V3 checker was made conservative for article-bearing broad IPA; pedagogical checker has warnings only for `oven mitt beside oven`.
- `home_kitchen_cooking_actions_a1_a2`: 0 deterministic IPA sanity blockers and 0 deterministic pedagogical blockers, but it still needs fresh `pronunciation_accuracy`, `target_example_pedagogical_quality` and refreshed V3 `example_quality` evidence before V3 final export.
- `home_kitchen_storage_cleaning_a2`: 403 IPA sanity blockers, mostly slash-wrapped orthography in IPA languages, plus 108 hard pedagogical blockers from base scenes `freezer bag in the freezer` and `kitchen shelf in the kitchen`.
- `home_bathroom_essentials_a1`: 83 IPA sanity blockers and 1 hard pedagogical blocker (`EN-GB` `shower head`: `The shower head is in the shower.`).

Repair policy: do not guess IPA. Existing decks stay repair-first, but IPA blockers require source-backed pronunciation repair through `import-transcription-repair.mjs`; weak examples require base/example repair first, then refreshed semantic/naturalness/lexical/pedagogical evidence. Until that repair is done, V3 correctly blocks final export/readiness.

Decision: strengthen future generation before database import. A generated language batch is no longer treated as import-ready just because it matches the JSONL shape. Implemented:

- added `scripts/check-language-batch-source-preflight.mjs <batch.jsonl|csv>` and shared preflight libraries;
- wired the same preflight into `scripts/import-language-batch.mjs`, so import refuses hard blockers before DB writes and always writes an import preflight report;
- added source-candidate reports under `outputs/source-preflight/`;
- added a current-value-locked source-preflight warning decision ledger for actionable warnings;
- added `scripts/check-source-preflight-warning-decisions.mjs` to validate warning-decision rows before they can be trusted by the import gate;
- added `scripts/check-reference-sources-cache.mjs` for local manifest/cache/tool-adapter health checks;
- added automatic high-risk/number-heavy profiling: one-language batch enforcement plus unresolved actionable warning-decision blockers;
- added draft example scene preflight for obvious pre-import drift, including number-deck meta-template examples that do not preserve the English canonical scene;
- added local UniMorph TSV and local Apertium JSONL/TSV/CSV readers that activate when ignored raw data is present;
- added `reference-sources/optional-tool-source-targets.json` and `scripts/fetch-optional-tool-sources.mjs` for project-local optional source downloads;
- downloaded optional UniMorph high-risk morphology tables for `BG`, `DE`, `ES`, `FR`, shared `HR`/`SR`, `IS`, `LV`, `PT`/`PT-BR` and `RO`, plus Apertium English-Spanish `.dix` candidate data;
- added `reference-sources/tool-runtime-requirements.txt`, ignored `.venv-source-tools/`, and installed project-local `epitran 1.35.1` plus `openphonemizer 0.1.2`;
- updated tool-source adapters to prefer `.venv-source-tools/bin/python` or `SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_PYTHON`, so local optional Python tools are visible to cache/preflight checks without modifying system Python;
- limited Epitran pre-import candidates to policy source-lookup phonetic/IPA languages, preventing false mismatch warnings for copy-display or deterministic-transliteration languages such as `ES`, `IT`, `RU` or `TR`;
- kept OpenPhonemizer installed/detected but inactive for candidate generation in v1, so import preflight does not download models or depend on model-cache side effects;
- added fixture coverage for Epitran `source_partial` candidates, slash-wrapped pseudo-IPA blockers, soft missing-tool behavior, UniMorph-style number mismatch, Apertium candidate support and number meta-template scene blockers;
- added `scripts/check-transcription-source-policy.mjs` as a quick source-policy/manifest consistency check.

Guardrails:

- tool output is candidate evidence only; it may produce `source_partial`, warnings and repair suggestions, but not final `source_exact` approval without dictionary/standard/manual current-value backing;
- missing optional tools or missing optional local UniMorph/Apertium data must warn, not crash;
- `--no-auto-warning-decisions` is diagnostic only and must not be used to bypass production high-risk import review;
- the gate is for future draft batches and does not regenerate old decks, mutate clean DB state or update Google Sheets by itself.

## 2026-04-30: Transcription Source Decision Pass

Decision: keep the existing mixed learner-facing `transcription` policy, but bind every one of the 54 active language variants to a primary/fallback source strategy before any future source-backed audit work. `docs/language-transcription-policy.md` remains the source of truth for the final user-facing format; `docs/reference-sources.md` now records the full 54-row decision matrix.

Closed decisions:

- IPA languages remain IPA and require source/tool-backed pronunciation evidence. Regional variants are explicit: `EN-GB` cannot silently inherit `EN`, and `PT-BR` cannot silently inherit `PT`.
- Native-orthography-copy languages keep copying the display form into `transcription`; source checks support spelling, diacritics and regional term choice but do not create a separate pronunciation value.
- Standard romanization/transliteration languages keep their current policy. Deterministic rules are auto-safe only when derived from the current native/display form; multi-reading or pronunciation-sensitive cases remain source-assisted/manual-review-required.
- `ZH` remains Simplified Chinese plus Hanyu Pinyin with tone marks. Tone numbers and tone-less pinyin are not final output.
- `TH` and `LO` remain learner romanization with tone diacritics. Official tone-less romanization systems are reference layers only.
- `MY` remains Burmese/Myanmar and uses practical learner romanization with tone/register support, not raw MLCTS-only output.
- `KM` remains practical Geographic Department / UNGEGN-based romanization and fails closed on source conflict.
- `SI` and Indic-script languages use ISO 15919, validated against ISO/CLDR/Aksharamukha-style references.

QA decision: transcription QA must be source/tool-backed. AI batch output alone cannot satisfy final pronunciation/transcription evidence. Executable gates must cover pseudo-IPA detection, tone-mark enforcement, source availability, regional mismatch and display-form/article coverage. This pass changed documentation only: no DB rows, cards, exports, Google Sheets, generation scripts or language batches were changed.
